newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Spanish Commissioner blocks milk penalties.
newsitem.headline: Spanish Commissioner blocks milk penalties.

text.p: Spanish Commissioner Marcelino Oreja blocked a European Commission attempt to force payment of milk "super-levy" fines on three countries by withholding European Union payments, a Commission official said on Monday.
Fischler sought approval from the rest of the Commission by what is known as a written procedure, but it was suspended on Monday by Oreja on the grounds that more information was needed.
"The two commissioners will now try to sort out the problem between them, and if not then the proposal will have to go to a full meeting of the Commission," a Commission official said.

The penalties were imposed after Italy overshot its 9.9 million tonnes annual milk production quota in 1995/96 by some 470,000 tonnes, Spain its quota of five million tonnes by some 120,000 tonnes and Greece its quota of some 625,000 tonnes by 7,000 tonnes.
Italy was ordered to pay 169 million Ecus, but paid only 61 million Ecus, while Spain was ordered to pay 43 million Ecus and Greece 1.7 million Ecus.

Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler proposed witholding 36 million Ecus per month for three months from Italy, 21.5 million Ecus per month for two months from Spain and 1.7 million Ecus in one month from Greece until the fines were cleared.
